profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California, trading under the ticker META. Its most recent 10-K, covering the period ending 2025-12-31, reports revenue of $200,966,000,000. Its developer site presents Meta's AI models and tools for builders, including Muse Spark, which the company says is reachable through Muse Code and the Meta Model API. Meta describes Muse Spark as tuned for long-horizon coding workflows, with fewer unnecessary turns and cleaner output, and says it performs competitively with frontier models across several coding evals. The site also advertises a quick start that produces a first working request in under five minutes by pointing an existing OpenAI SDK compatible client at the Meta Model API, and search grounding that gives a model live access to the web through a single tool added to a request.

The product tracked for Meta is Llama (Meta), an open-weight model family that is often self-hosted. MCP servers associated with Meta Ads work include ai.adweave/meta-ads-mcp, described as having 47 tools for campaigns, creatives, audiences, and insights; co.pipeboard/meta-ads-mcp, for Facebook and Meta Ads automation with AI, including performance analysis, creative testing, and spend optimization; and com.adbloop/meta-ads, for bulk-creating Facebook and Instagram ads across accounts from Drive folders.

Court records listed for Meta include State of New Mexico ex rel. Torrez v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the First Judicial District Court, Santa Fe County, New Mexico; Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the District Court for the Western District of Texas; Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the District Court for the Northern District of California; and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California. Its recorded litigation exposure is concentrated in California, with 281 cases there.
